Disclosed in public_note. Rights: study-authored question grid (paired with the INFO block, c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_infosource); the measures docs cite no source instrument. Value labels 1 Strongly disagree .. 5 Strongly agree identical on all 10 items; no reverse coding in the build, items stored raw (2,4,5,6,8,9,10 are anti-vaccine-worded). Agent cross-check .sav vs live: 50/50 item x resp cells identical (live 14015 rows / 1405 ids, W2 only). Stem (Q313) in instructions; single section. RIGHTS: no block, shipped on silence (irw#1945). The block is study-composed -- measures information 2.2.7.17 says the vaccine questions were developed following consultation with a range of sources and measures, citing Horne et al. 2015 PNAS, Martin & Petrie 2017 (VAX), Shapiro et al. 2016 (VCBS), Yaqub et al. 2014. Several statements are adapted from those scales (item 6 ~ VAX Authorities promote vaccination for financial gain; item 9 ~ VAX Being exposed to diseases naturally is safer...; item 4 merges VCBS deceived-about-safety/efficacy items; item 7 ~ Horne 2015 Vaccinating healthy children helps protect others...). None is in instrument_rights_register.csv; VAX and VCBS were shipped on silence in batch_128/batch_129 (pavic_2022_*), where the VAX PDF on Petrie lab page and the VCBS Elsevier CC BY-NC-ND article licence (article licence, not an instrument term) were examined. No fee/permission/NC/ND/no-redistribution clause located for any source; not exhaustive. No register row written (rounds may not write ship).
